description: Source code for hdr_histogram implementation, including functions for histogram creation, updating, querying, and iteration, with atomic operations support.

methods.name: normalize_index
methods.description: Normalizes an index based on the histogram's normalizing offset.

methods.name: counts_get_direct
methods.description: Retrieves the count at a specific index directly.

methods.name: counts_get_normalised
methods.description: Retrieves the normalized count at a specific index.

methods.name: counts_inc_normalised
methods.description: Increments the normalized count at a given index.

methods.name: counts_inc_normalised_atomic
methods.description: Atomically increments the normalized count at a given index.

methods.name: update_min_max
methods.description: Updates min and max values of the histogram.

methods.name: update_min_max_atomic
methods.description: Atomically updates min and max values.

methods.name: power
methods.description: Calculates base raised to the power exp.

methods.name: count_leading_zeros_64
methods.description: Counts leading zeros in a 64-bit integer.

methods.name: get_bucket_index
methods.description: Calculates bucket index for a value.

methods.name: get_sub_bucket_index
methods.description: Calculates sub-bucket index for a value.

methods.name: counts_index
methods.description: Calculates the counts array index for bucket and sub-bucket indices.

methods.name: value_from_index
methods.description: Calculates value from bucket and sub-bucket indices.

methods.name: counts_index_for
methods.description: Calculates counts array index for a value.

methods.name: hdr_value_at_index
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specific index.

methods.name: hdr_size_of_equivalent_value_range
methods.description: Calculates size of the range of equivalent values for a given value.

methods.name: size_of_equivalent_value_range_given_bucket_indices
methods.description: Calculates size of the range given bucket and sub-bucket indices.

methods.name: lowest_equivalent_value
methods.description: Calculates the lowest equivalent value for a given value.

methods.name: lowest_equivalent_value_given_bucket_indices
methods.description: Calculates lowest equivalent value given bucket and sub-bucket indices.

methods.name: hdr_next_non_equivalent_value
methods.description: Calculates the next non-equivalent value after a given value.

methods.name: highest_equivalent_value
methods.description: Calculates the highest equivalent value for a given value.

methods.name: hdr_median_equivalent_value
methods.description: Calculates the median equivalent value for a given value.

methods.name: non_zero_min
methods.description: Returns the minimum non-zero value in the histogram.

methods.name: hdr_reset
methods.description: Resets the histogram counts and counters to zero.

methods.name: hdr_get_memory_size
methods.description: Returns the memory size of the histogram.

methods.name: hdr_record_value
methods.description: Records a single value into the histogram.

methods.name: hdr_record_value_atomic
methods.description: Atomically records a single value into the histogram.

methods.name: hdr_record_values
methods.description: Records multiple counts of a value.

methods.name: hdr_record_values_atomic
methods.description: Atomically records multiple counts of a value.

methods.name: hdr_record_corrected_value
methods.description: Records a value with correction for expected interval.

methods.name: hdr_record_corrected_value_atomic
methods.description: Atomically records a value with correction for expected interval.

methods.name: hdr_record_corrected_values
methods.description: Records multiple counts with correction for expected interval.

methods.name: hdr_record_corrected_values_atomic
methods.description: Atomically records multiple counts with correction for expected interval.

methods.name: hdr_add
methods.description: Adds data from another histogram.

methods.name: hdr_add_while_correcting_for_coordinated_omission
methods.description: Adds data from another histogram with correction for coordinated omission.

methods.name: hdr_max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value recorded.

methods.name: hdr_min
methods.description: Returns the minimum value recorded.

methods.name: hdr_value_at_percentile
methods.description: Returns the value at a given percentile.

methods.name: hdr_value_at_percentiles
methods.description: Returns values at multiple percentiles.

methods.name: hdr_mean
methods.description: Calculates the mean of the recorded values.

methods.name: hdr_stddev
methods.description: Calculates the standard deviation of the recorded values.

methods.name: hdr_values_are_equivalent
methods.description: Checks if two values are equivalent.

methods.name: hdr_lowest_equivalent_value
methods.description: Returns the lowest equivalent value.

methods.name: hdr_count_at_value
methods.description: Returns the count at a specific value.

methods.name: hdr_count_at_index
methods.description: Returns the count at a specific index.

methods.name: hdr_iter_init
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for the histogram.

methods.name: hdr_iter_next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next value.

methods.name: hdr_iter_percentile_init
methods.description: Initializes a percentile iterator.

methods.name: hdr_iter_recorded_init
methods.description: Initializes a recorded values iterator.

methods.name: hdr_percentiles_print
methods.description: Prints histogram percentiles to a stream.
